svg.text: CARD IS FULL-WIDTH; DEMO W IS A REFERENCE.
LABEL TRUNCATES; VALUE / UNIT / STEPPERS HUG.
HOVER PREVIEW HAS NO LENS; SLIDING HEAD HIDES.
LENS IS A RAISED COSINE, REACH S8 EACH SIDE.
TICKS GROW; PITCH AND BASELINE STAY FIXED.
SLIDING HEAD: EDGE ZONES SCROLL THE RULER.
FIXED HEAD: RULER MOVES UNDER THE CENTRE.
HIDDEN RANGE INPUT COVERS THE ROOT.
KEYBOARD / FOCUS / FORM SEMANTICS USE IT.
CALLER SUPPLIES ITS VISIBLE LABEL AND WIDTH.
CONTENT CENTRE: H1 ÷ 2 − S2; RULER BASELINE: H1 − S3.
LABEL / VALUE WIDTHS FOLLOW CONTENT; NO TEXT WIDTH IS SPECIFIED.
SCALE 5:1 · MD · ACTIVE INDICATOR AT CENTRE

g.text: L(d) = ½·(1 + cos(π·|d| / S8)) WHEN |d| < S8; ELSE 0.
TICK HEIGHT = REST + L·(H7 − REST). POSITION = (TICK − OFFSET)·S7.

svg.text: PROPORTIONAL · VERTICAL SEPARATION NOT A CSS VALUE
LAYER GAPS ARE EXPLANATORY; NO SCRIM OR PORTAL.
RANGE INPUT IS INVISIBLE; POINTERS BELONG TO ROOT.
OUTLINE-GHOST ADDS SHADOW; CARD ADDS FILL; PLAIN ADDS NEITHER.
SCALE 1.5:1 · SM · NO CHEVRONS · W IS CALLER-SET
OPTIONAL PAIR; GAP S4 TO VALUE.
BUTTON HIT = Z1; NO EXPANDED TARGET.
MEASURED: 1800 PX VIEWPORT · LIGHT · 16 PX ROOT · FONTS READY.
